title: Part Six: Housing: The Asset That Built the Dream

sections.brief: Pre-1930 balloon mortgages and Depression foreclosures; HOLC (1933) and FHA (1934) and the long amortising loan (20-year 1934, 30-year 1948, 95% LTV 1956) as designed friction that worked (43.6% to 64% ownership 1940-80); HOLC maps 1935-40 and FHA 1938 Underwriting Manual racial restrictions; Aaronson-Hartley-Mazumder vs Fishback-Rose-Snowden-Storrs dispute; GI Bill (Katznelson, Mississippi 2 of 3,229; Turner and Bound); Levittown clause 25; Shelley 1948, Fair Housing Act 1968; Fed note on bottom-tercile ownership; Black-white ownership gap 27 (1960) to 29.1 (2026); Euclid and single-family zoning, Glaeser-Gyourko, state reforms. Figures: compare; time

JCHS price-to-income 3.1-3.4 (1980-99) to 5.0 (2024), vintage caveat (5.6 for 2022); metro spread; mortgage rate 7.40% (15 Oct 2026) and payment arithmetic; owner burdens; homeownership 65.0% and under-35 35.2%; NAR first-time buyers 21%, age 40 with method caveat; renter burden 49% record and loss of sub-$1,000 units; rents falling where supply grew; institutional investors 2-5% of SFR stock vs the circulating claim; EO 14376 and the ROAD to Housing Act (signed 11 July 2026, effective about 7 Jan 2027). Figures: stats; compare (told vs record); compare (investor claim)

Eviction prevalence (3.6m filings/2.7m households 2000-18; 1.23m in 48 tracked sites 2025); Desmond's Evicted and its critics; record inaccuracy (Porton et al. 22%) and what the CFPB 2022 report does and does not say; TransUnion $15m (2023); contract for deed in Chicago (Duke 2019) and Harbour Portfolio after 2008, Pew 36m; RealPage DOJ suit, Nov 2025 settlement approved May 2026, $359.9m landlord class settlements Oct 2026, NY law enjoined Sept 2026; HUD 2025 PIT; labelled interpretation of the 'eviction machine'. Figures: flow; money; time
